# FarmsKing - Smart Agriculture & Crop Intelligence Platform

> FarmsKing (https://farmsking.in) is India's leading Smart Farming and Agricultural Intelligence Platform, operated by **FARMSKING TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED** (CIN: U01100PB2026PTC063294, ROC Chandigarh), governed by its Board of Directors and certified executive management team, supported by certified agronomists, software engineers, and progressive farmers across India.

## Corporate Governance & Administration
- **Statutory Administration**: Governed by the Board of Directors under the Companies Act, 2013 and ROC Chandigarh.
- **Central Agronomy Operations**: Directing nationwide agronomic validation, mandi networks, and field quality assurance.
- **Technical Support & Systems Engineering**: Managing 24/7 cloud reliability, IoT telemetry, and platform infrastructure.
- **Specialist Agronomy Advisory**: Certified FarmsKing Agronomist Panel, soil scientists, and commercial floriculture experts.

## Corporate Offices
- **Statutory Registered Office**: VPO Goindwal Sahib, Tehsil Khadur Sahib, District Tarn Taran, Punjab - 143422, India.
- **Corporate Headquarters & Operational Office**: Near Grain Market, Makhu, District Ferozepur, Punjab - 142044, India.
- **Helpline**: 95776-22000 (Monday – Saturday • 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM IST)
- **Official Emails**: support@farmsking.in / farmskingindia@gmail.com / grievance@farmsking.in

## Core Mission & Philosophy
- **Farming Easy, Farming Smart**: Making advanced agricultural AI and satellite telemetry effortless, accessible, and highly profitable for Indian farmers.
- **Practical Problem Solving**: Built to resolve real-time crop disease detection (<820ms), APMC market price discovery, and soil degradation issues.
- **100% Genuine Organic Inputs**: Guaranteed zero fake products, delivering microbial vermicompost, marigold farming blueprints, and bio-nutrients.
- **Strict Scope Boundaries**: Zero sales of hardware or physical machinery, zero equipment rentals, and zero machinery manufacturing. 100% dedicated to digital software, AI diagnostics, live mandi rates, and organic bio-inputs.

## Platform Capabilities & Offerings
- **AI Crop Doctor**: Real-time multimodal computer vision leaf disease pathology and ICAR-calibrated spray recommendations.
- **Live Mandi Intelligence**: Daily wholesale arrivals and price trends across 50+ crops and major APMC markets nationwide.
- **Satellite Telemetry**: 6-constellation satellite remote sensing (Sentinel-2, ISRO Bhuvan) providing NDVI crop health and moisture index.
- **Digital Bahi-Khata (Account King)**: Transparent digital ledger and farm accounting for cultivators.
- **Upcoming Live Plants Delivery (Garden King)**: Doorstep delivery of healthy live nursery plants, herbs, and ornamental flora.
